text: Jess's housewarming is Saturday 14 Nov. Bring a plant, she said no more candles. Her flatmate Ruby is doing the food. Jess was saying the move nearly broke her, the landlord at the old place kept her deposit and she's still fighting it. Ask her how that's going when I see her, and maybe offer to help hang pictures the weekend after.
lwazi flying to joburg 3rd dec, back 2 jan. 11 hr flight, he hates long haul. text him the day before
Ayesha got promoted to team lead!! starts the new role 1 Dec. Must send congrats tonight

So Mustafa was telling me at lunch that his manager Rachel is leaving in March and nobody knows who's replacing her. He's quietly hoping it's him but doesn't want to jinx it. Said the client pitch on 9/11 went badly the week before and he's worried that'll count against him.
Dinner at Ifeoma's cancelled, her kids have chickenpox. Rescheduling for after half term.

Theo and Vera are off to Japan 2nd of April for three weeks. Tokyo first, then Kyoto. Their anniversary falls the week after they land, so Theo's secretly booked a ryokan with a private onsen. Vera has no idea. He asked me to keep quiet and also to water their plants while they're away, which I said I'd do. Keys from him the night before they fly.
Rahul - vegan now, mostly. also into bouldering
need to book airport parking for 18/12 and sort the dog sitter

Moira's 60th is a surprise do at the golf club on 21 Nov. Her husband Yosef is organising, wants everyone there by 7. I'm doing the cake. Yosef says she'll pretend to be annoyed but will love it. She's been dropping hints about wanting a proper pair of binoculars for birdwatching, so maybe a few of us chip in. Need to ask Jess and Theo by the 10th.
Tamar said Bilal's been off work since the 2nd with his back. Physio Thursday. Should check in with him a few days after.
Yasmin's leaving drinks Friday at the Crown. She starts at Deloitte the Monday after.
Note for Luis: he asked for the deck by 5th Nov, client review is the next day. Don't forget to send it the morning of the 4th at latest.
archie passed his driving test!! third attempt. bought him a keyring as a joke
Mateo and Sana engaged — party at theirs 28 November. ask what they want, Sana hinted at a cocktail shaker
Anan's back from Bangkok, jet lag destroyed him. Brought me back some dried mango.
Caitlin from accounts is nervous about her presentation to the board on 12 Nov. Wish her luck that morning, and ask how it went the day after.

um so just got off the phone with Jack, he's moving to Lisbon in January for work, the company's relocating his whole team. his girlfriend Dana's going with him but she has to quit her job. leaving do is probably the 9th of jan. I should get him something for the new flat, he mentioned wanting a decent coffee grinder
Rhys - wife Natasha, two boys, one at uni in Leeds. Supports Cardiff.
Lukas's dad had a fall last week, in hospital still. Lukas flying to Munich tomorrow to be with him.
Ring Stefan before his interview at the bank Weds
Nina invited us to her 40th, 6th Dec, fancy dress. Theme is the 80s.

Fang's mum is visiting from Chengdu 1st to 30th Nov. Fang is a bit stressed about hosting her for a whole month. Small flat, her mum doesn't speak much English, and Fang's got a big deadline at work the same week she arrives. Said she'd love a night out at some point just to breathe. I should invite her round for dinner mid month.
Matteo Fernández, new client contact. Goes by Teo. Big Juventus fan. Has a labrador called Pippo.
Christmas party at work is 18 Dec, Ruby's on the committee. Theme TBC.
got the flights to Lagos for Ifeoma's sister's wedding, 15 Feb out, 22nd back. Ifeoma's sister is Sana, not Ifeoma herself, keep getting that wrong. Need a gift list from Sana
Dana cat Biscuit went missing on Sunday. Back now, turned up two days later at a neighbour's.
Jess and Lwazi split up apparently. So the joint birthday thing in Nov is off. Jess seemed okay but quiet.
follow up with Mustafa — the Okafor account meeting was yesterday, find out if they signed

Vera's brother Matteo is getting married in Crete 7th June. She's maid of honour, flying out a week before. Terrified of the speech. She's been writing drafts since August and hates every one of them. Her mum keeps adding things she wants included. I offered to listen to it over FaceTime the weekend before she flies. Must actually do that, she'll be too polite to chase me.
Rachel off on maternity from 1 Feb, due 20th. Team are doing a collection — chip in.
Yosef recommended a tapas place in Seville, Las Teresas. For the trip.
Bilal says his daughter starts reception in September, they're touring schools this month

Okay voice note. Dinner with Tamar and her husband last night was lovely. They're thinking of emigrating to Canada, maybe Vancouver, maybe Toronto, not decided. She's got an interview with a hospital there on the 3rd of November, video call, and then if it goes well they'd fly over in January to look at places. Remind me to message her afterwards to see how it went. Oh, and she's gluten free now, so remember that next time they come over.
Luis back from Mexico Monday. Jet lag. His grandma's funeral was the reason he went.
take the Sato file home, prep Tues
Ayesha's hen do is in Lisbon 3 to 5 May. Flights booked. Need to pay Caitlin back for the Airbnb before the end of the month.
Saw Anan at the gym, his wife Yasmin just had their second, a girl, born 14/10. Named Moira after his gran. Need to send something.
Moira retiring end of Dec after 32 years. Leaving lunch 19th. Sign the card that week.
Uncle Rahul's in town 10th to 12th Nov. Mum wants us all at hers for dinner the Saturday. I'm picking him up from Heathrow.
ifeoma: hates coriander. allergic to cashews. loves Afrobeats
Theo was rambling about his marathon in Valencia 6th Dec. Hasn't trained much, bit nervous. Ask him how it went the next day.
Rubbish week. Nothing much to note.
Jack's boss Mrs Olsen keeps scheduling 7am calls with the US team. He's exhausted, thinking about looking elsewhere.
Natasha and Rhys celebrating 20 years married on the 30th of Nov. Renewing vows in Tenerife the week after. Get a card.
Archie's sister Ruby is doing her first gig with her band at the Fleece 22 Nov, he's asked if I can come. Said yes. Should buy tickets tonight.

Stefan didn't get the bank job. Gutted. Got another interview at Barclays next Thursday though. Text him the night before to say good luck. He said the Barclays one is more his thing anyway, risk team not trading, and it's hybrid so he'd see more of his little boy. Sounded a bit flat on the phone though, so maybe just ring instead.
Fang — big into board games, collects Warhammer, hates mushrooms
Sana Chen from the Leeds office is coming down 11 and 12 Nov for the audit. Book her a desk, and a room for the Tuesday.
Mateo said his partner Luis passed his citizenship test last week, they're throwing a little party Sat. bring wine
Nina's dad's having a knee op on 4 Nov. She's taking the week off to help. Check in with her a few days after.
Housewarming at Rahul and Ruby's new place in Bristol, 7th of Dec. They moved in mid Oct. Ruby said they need everything, but mainly a good doormat lol. Maybe get them one.
Pick up suit from dry cleaners before Friday. Passport renewal — sent 2nd Oct, should arrive by 30/10.
Lukas's leaving do is the 15th. He's off to Berlin, starting at a startup the Monday after. Bring the card I got.
Caitlin mentioned her mum's 70th next month, they're taking her to Paris for the weekend. Said her mum's never been abroad before.
so Tamar's interview went really well, they want her for a second round on 12 Nov, in person in Toronto. flying out the 10th, back the day after. remind me to call her when she's back
Yasmin - works in procurement at the council. Two cats, Salt and Pepper. Lives in Hove.
Vera mentioned she's really struggling since her dog Ziggy was put to sleep in Sept. Should take her out for coffee next week.

Meeting with Jensen Ltd moved to 28/10, 10am. Prep the numbers the day before and send the summary to Dana afterwards. Her boss wants it in writing this time after the mix up in September, when the figures in the deck didn't match the spreadsheet and the client noticed. Not making that mistake twice.
Big day tomorrow — flying to Singapore for the conference, 13 hours. Packed. Charger, adaptors, melatonin.
Bilal 'Billy' Evans - new starter on our team from Monday. Ex-Amazon. Seems shy. Getting married in the spring apparently, 12th of April.
